findings.claim: 26.5% of customers churned (target class Churn = 'Yes'); the dataset is imbalanced toward non-churners.
findings.evidence_sql_or_code: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN Churn = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS churn_rate FROM data

findings.claim: 11 rows have a blank (whitespace-only) TotalCharges value -- these are the tenure-0 customers who have not been billed yet.
findings.evidence_sql_or_code: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN trim(TotalCharges) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_blank FROM data

data_quality_issues: TotalCharges is read as VARCHAR, not numeric, because 11 rows hold a single-space string instead of a number; it must be coerced with pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce') and the resulting NaNs handled before it can be used as a model feature.

baseline.notes: accuracy=0.7722 on a stratified 80/20 train/test split (random_state=42), features standardized.

caveats: Baseline uses 3 numeric features only; categorical service and contract features (Contract, InternetService, PaymentMethod, ...) were profiled but not yet included, and would likely improve the model.
Single train/test split, no cross-validation -- metric_value has some variance across seeds.
